name: Viro (character)
means: Makes the same young man appear across shots on the anime engine - two-tone hair, square jaw, heavy brows - instead of a fresh person who merely matches the description.
verdict: MEASURED by looking at three rendered panels. studio/samples/cast/viro_anime_demo.jpg against viro_anime_nolora_demo.jpg, eight places at matched seeds: WITH the LoRA the same adult man appears in all eight - pale blond over the crown falling to a dark brown curly ponytail, square jaw, heavy brows, broad shoulders. WITHOUT it the subject reads younger and more androgynous, plain brown hair, no two-tone, and drifts noticeably between panels. It holds a face. IT ALSO DRAGS ITS TRAINING SET'S LOOK ALONG WITH THE FACE, and that is the real cost: with-LoRA backgrounds go flat, pale and graphic where the control gives atmospheric depth. studio/samples/cast/viro_loracheck.jpg is the blunt version - the no-LoRA panel is a dark neon alley with a small distant figure, the with-viro panel at the same seed is a bright centred medium shot of him. Framing and palette come along too. Compare studio/samples/cast/VIRO/00_front.png and the flat cream studio background it was trained on and the reason is obvious.
note: base_model is READ rather than inferred, but from the TRAINING GRAPH, not the header - the file has no __metadata__ at all, because ComfyUI's SaveLoRA writes none. workflows/33_train_character_lora.json node 2 is CheckpointLoaderSimple{animagine-xl-4.0.safetensors}, node 5 TrainLoraNode{rank 16, steps 1000, lr 5e-4, AdamW, MSE, bf16, seed 7311}, node 6 SaveLoRA{prefix loras/character_viro}; the file's rank 16 and BF16 match exactly. | KEY-FAMILY CROSS-CHECK, independent of the filename: the file carries `label_emb`, the SDXL pooled/size-conditioning embedder. SD1.5 has no such key. The keys confirm SDXL on their own. | THE BASE LOCK IS PROVEN IN THE LOG, not only from pixels. ~/ComfyUI/user/comfyui_8188.log reports '1168 patches attached' on SDXL runs; at 2026-08-03 19:20:51, immediately after a QwenImage load, it rejects every one of this LoRA's keys. All 68,628 'lora key not loaded' lines in that log are SDXL-shaped. On qwen this does NOTHING - not less, nothing, silently. | trigger 'viro' is evidenced from the training captions still on disk, not from the file: all 16 of ~/ComfyUI/input/viro_train/*.txt begin 'viro, ' ('viro, front', 'viro, three quarter', 'viro, full body'). | MODEL-ONLY. TrainLoraNode patched MODEL, so there are zero text-encoder keys; load with LoraLoaderModelOnly. | scripts/short.py injects it as synthetic node '90' inside anime_keyframe ONLY (short.py:290-301, from film['character_loras']) and then rewrites every ['1',0] MODEL edge to ['90',0]. The qwen branch never reads character_loras - compose.py:698-701 already documents that as a silent cross-layer failure. | strength_range is a judgement, not a sweep: 0.85 is the short.py default (character_lora_weight) and is the value in the panels above. Nobody has swept it. Given how much scene look it carries, the useful experiment is DOWNWARD - whether 0.5-0.6 keeps the face and gives the background back.
example_note: Left cell is the control at strength 0. A LoRA is a delta on the base weights, so a single with-the-LoRA image proves nothing - the OFF cell is the evidence.
